verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an AI model and assistant provider, so the axis applies. The pack only shows developer building blocks: a function-calling API, a developer-preview harness for agent harness developers, and use as a backend model inside third-party tools like Claude Code. None of these is a first-party feature for setting up recurring or autonomous background automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
